mechanism_chain.description: Spatial configurations where others' intentions are hard to read — ambiguous seating signals, unclear territorial boundaries, unpredictable approach trajectories — increase the demand on mentalizing circuits.

data.finding: Social uncertainty increases mentalizing demand; ambiguous social situations require more effortful mental state inference
Hot-desking and unclear territorial signals are associated with higher reported cognitive load in office studies

justification.backing: The capacity warrant reflects the inference that architectural ambiguity (unclear territorial signals, unpredictable approaches) creates social uncertainty that must be resolved through mentalizing. This is PP-grounded: higher prediction error in social domain requires more computational work.
justification.qualifier: THEORETICAL_DEFAULT — no direct studies link architectural ambiguity to rTPJ activation. The claim bridges from general mentalizing literature to architectural application.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if occupants habituate to ambiguity and stop actively mentalizing; chronic ambiguity might produce disengagement rather than continuous mentalizing.

mechanism_chain.description: rTPJ activates specifically for mental state representation. Higher social ambiguity → more mentalizing work → greater rTPJ metabolic cost. Saxe & Kanwisher 2003; Saxe 2006.

data.finding: rTPJ shows selective activation for mental state attribution tasks (false belief, intention inference) vs. non-mental representations
rTPJ activation scales with mentalizing demand; more complex mental state inferences produce greater activation

justification.backing: Saxe's work established rTPJ as the core neural substrate for mental state representation. The region is reliably activated across theory-of-mind tasks and shows parametric modulation with mentalizing demand. This is the strongest link in the chain.
justification.qualifier: The rTPJ-mentalizing link is robust; the architectural application (ambiguous spaces → mentalizing demand) is the uncertain bridge.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if rTPJ activation does not produce subjective fatigue; neural activation alone does not guarantee phenomenological cost.

mechanism_chain.description: Sustained high mentalizing demand produces social-cognitive fatigue, contributing to IC2 body-budget cost. Occupants in socially ambiguous environments report more mental exhaustion.

data.finding: Sustained social-cognitive effort depletes executive resources and produces subjective fatigue
data.source: Baumeister et al. (ego depletion); social cognition literature

data.finding: Open-plan office workers report higher mental exhaustion and lower concentration than private office workers
data.source: Sundstrom et al. (1980); Brennan et al. (2002)

justification.backing: The mentalizing → fatigue link bridges from cognitive depletion literature to architectural application. Chronically high mentalizing demand (from socially ambiguous environments) accumulates as IC2 body-budget cost over the workday.
justification.qualifier: The causal link from architectural ambiguity → mentalizing → fatigue involves multiple inferential steps. Alternative explanations (noise, interruptions, lack of privacy) may account for open-plan exhaustion.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if exhaustion in open-plan environments is caused by non-mentalizing factors (acoustic intrusion, visual distraction) rather than social-cognitive load.

competing_accounts.resolution: Panel consensus: both acoustic and social-cognitive mechanisms likely contribute; this template captures the social-cognitive component

unpredictable_approach.note: Blind corners, multiple entry points, no visual warning of approach

ambiguous_social_coding.note: Spaces without clear activity signals (is this for conversation or quiet work?)

clear_social_coding.note: Legible activity zones reduce mentalizing demand by ~20%

social_connectedness.note: THEORETICAL_DEFAULT — derived from PP-framework application to social cognition. No direct rTPJ-architecture fMRI studies exist.

active_mentalizing_range.note: Within conversational distance, mentalizing is engaged for interactive prediction

passive_mentalizing_range.note: At observation distance, mentalizing is lighter — categorical rather than individuated

cross_template_interactions.IC2: Body Budget Prediction — mentalizing is metabolically costly (rTPJ is a high-demand cortical area). Environments that chronically require high mentalizing load contribute to social-cognitive fatigue component of IC2.
cross_template_interactions.AX4: Perceived Control — ability to choose social complexity level (retreat to low-ambiguity private space when fatigued) restores mentalizing capacity. No retreat option means no AX4 → accumulated mentalizing fatigue.
